description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the RV5C386A Real Time Clock (RTC) used in WL-HDD devices. It includes functions for reading and setting the RTC time via I2C, platform detection, and device registration.

methods.name: rtc_open
methods.description: Opens the RTC device, initializes I2C, and locks the device for exclusive access.

methods.name: rtc_read
methods.description: Reads the current RTC time and outputs it in a formatted string.

methods.name: rtc_write
methods.description: Sets the RTC time based on a formatted string input.

methods.name: rtc_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for reading and setting RTC time.

methods.name: get_rtc_time
methods.description: Reads the current time from the RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: set_rtc_time
methods.description: Writes the specified time to the RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: platform_detect
methods.description: Detects platform-specific GPIO pin configuration based on device info.

methods.name: rtc_init
methods.description: Initializes the RTC driver, detects platform, and switches RTC to 24h mode.

methods.name: rtc_exit
methods.description: Cleans up and deregisters the RTC device.
